title: McCasland's wife tweets about alien abduction by a mother ship

tellings.quote: she then follows up on Twitter and she says like, you know, maybe the best explanation for this is an alien having, you know, abducted him from a mother ship, although no mother ship has been found in the local area.

plain: After a man named McCasland vanished in New Mexico, his wife reportedly posted on Twitter that maybe the best explanation was that an alien had abducted him from a mother ship, "although no mother ship has been found in the local area." Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and reads the post as a pointed, sarcastic remark from someone close to the case.
